verdict.rationale: Kick connects banking via Plaid (with manual PDF/CSV backfill for unsupported institutions), syncs payment/invoicing data from Stripe, Mercury, Ramp, and BILL, and posts payroll runs directly as journal entries into a real double-entry ledger with automated AI categorization. missing for 10: explicit named payroll provider integrations (e.g., Gusto/Rippling) beyond the generic 'payroll run' mention, and independent third-party corroboration beyond Kick's own docs.
